title: PF2e Animist Command Deck
description: Complete tactical Spirit Command Deck HUD, built-in War of Immortals & Lost Omens Apparition Compendium (all 14 Apparitions, 14 Vessel Spells, 4 Practices, and Wandering Feats), Pathmuncher-aware sheet & spellbook synchronizer, full combat automation (Circle of Spirits, Cast & Sustain Vessel Spells with Spell DC saves, healing pulses, Trickster's Mirrors, Grasping Spirits pull, Channeler's Stance, and Shaman Spirit Familiar), and visual PIXI token spirit orbs & emanation rings for Pathfinder 2e.
